subject: Post-call recap: Munro Health buying process + security delivery plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kate Munro <kate@munrohealth.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@munrohealth.com>, procurement@munrohealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: Munro Health buying process + security delivery plan

Kate / Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the decision timeline and evidence delivery.

Summary of call:
- Use case: downsampled PHI-lite patient summary generation for care coordination.
- Primary success criteria: latency < 300ms p95 for 512-token prompts, and no PHI persisted beyond session TTL.
- Decision target: ~end of May (you mentioned May 30).

Stakeholders (as we heard):
- Economic buyer: CFO (you to confirm name)
- Procurement: Liam / procurement@munrohealth.com
- Security / Privacy: Anika Rao (you mentioned she will lead the controls review)

Security evidence asks we discussed:
1) SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter if in progress)
2) Penetration test summary / remediation plan
3) Audit log export examples and retention policy
4) Data retention & deletion policy for customer data

Our proposed delivery commitments (we can adjust based on your timeline):
- SOC 2 / bridge letter: by 2028-05-10
- Pen test summary: by 2028-05-12
- Sample audit log export (S3 CSV sample + schema): by 2028-05-08
- Data retention policy doc: 2028-05-06

Attachments: redwood-security-one-pager.pdf, SOC2-checklist.xlsx (attached for your internal checklist).

Next steps — please:
- Confirm the economic buyer contact and final decision date.
- Confirm that the items above cover Anika's requirements or flag any additional evidence.
- If procurement has a PO template or legal redline owner, share contact (we'll route contract questions to Karthik).

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up where Karthik (legal) and Monica (solutions/CS) join to walk the artifacts.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Munro Health buying process + security delivery plan

Thanks Aditya — helpful recap. Confirmations and a couple notes below.

Confirmations:
- Decision target: still targeting 2028-05-30 (leadership review on May 28, final PO by May 30).
- Procurement lead is Liam (copied).
- Security/Privacy lead is Anika Rao (anika.rao@munrohealth.com) — she'll own the control checklist.

Anika's asks (she asked me to call these out early):
- If you have a SOC 2 Type II report, that’s ideal; if not, a recent bridge letter + evidence matrix is OK for the May 28 review.
- Pen test executive summary is required; full report can be redacted.
- Audit logs: we need a sample export and confirmation you can retain logs for at least 12 months. Export format preference: JSON or CSV (either ok).
- Data retention: high-level policy + ability to set a customer-specific retention period (we typically request 12–24 months).

Procurement notes: Liam — for speed we can accept a standard PO once legal terms are agreed. If you have a Master Services Agreement redline, please send to Karthik (cc'd to this thread).

I've attached our security questionnaire (Munro-Security-Questionnaire.pdf) — you can map artifacts to the questions and return the completed version.

Happy to jump on a 30-min walkthrough with your security lead next week.

—Kate
Kate Munro
Head of Product Operations, Munro Health
kate@munrohealth.com

Attachment stubs: Munro-Security-Questionnaire.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kate Munro <kate@munrohealth.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@munrohealth.com>, procurement@munrohealth.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2028 11:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Munro Health buying process + security delivery plan

Kate / team — thanks for the clarity. Quick note on what Redwood can provide and how we'll map to your questionnaire.

What we can provide now:
- SOC 2 Type II report: our latest is 2027-11 Type II. If you need a current attestation, we can provide a bridge letter + evidence matrix matching the Munro questionnaire by 2028-05-10.
- Pen test: executive summary + remediation notes (suitable for procurement/legal review) by 2028-05-12.
- Audit logs: we can export logs to an S3 bucket in CSV or JSON. We'll include sample files and the schema. Retention policy is configurable; default is 12 months and we support 12–36 months on dedicated plans.
- Data retention & deletion: we'll provide the customer-facing data retention policy and a short runbook for deletion requests by 2028-05-06.

Process notes for contracts:
- Please send any MSA redlines to me at this address. For PO-based buys we typically accept a signed PO with the negotiated MSA attached.
- If Munro requires any SLAs outside of our standard commitment, call that out and we can route through our legal/ops for review.

Proposed next call: Tuesday 2028-05-09 16:00 ET — 30 minutes with Anika, Karthik, Monica, and Aditya to map questionnaire -> evidence in real time. Does that work?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal & Contracts, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Hi Kate / Anika / Liam — looping in the CS/solutions side with a short delivery checklist and tentative dates so you can plan your review.

Redwood deliverables (tentative):
- 2028-05-06: Data retention & deletion policy doc (includes example retention TTLs and deletion runbook).
- 2028-05-08: Sample audit log export (CSV + JSON schema) and instructions for S3 ingest.
- 2028-05-10: SOC 2 artifact package or bridge letter + evidence mapping to Munro questionnaire.
- 2028-05-12: Pen test executive summary and remediation timeline.

What we'd ask from Munro to keep timeline tight:
- Completed Munro-Security-Questionnaire (even partial) by 2028-05-07 so we can map artifacts directly.
- Procurement PO template / target T&Cs or MSA redlines (send to Karthik) by 2028-05-09.
- Confirm decision-maker name for final sign-off so we can prepare executive summary for leadership.

If the above dates are too aggressive, let us know and we'll prioritize the items you need for the May 28 leadership review.

I'll prepare a simple evidence matrix matching Munro's questionnaire and share it back in this thread by EOD Monday.

Best,
